book.name: Kawandila
book.title: Kawandila xa Kitaabui Kawandila xa Kitaabui

content: N man bara n xaxili rasiga ɲaxankatɛ birin ma, naxan na rabafe yi duniɲa ma.

content.text: Mixi ɲaxankataxi na wafe,
e madunduma yo mu na.
Nɔɛ na mixie bɛ naxee na e ɲaxankatafe.
E madunduma yo mu na.
N bara a maɲɔxun, mixi faxaxi nan sɛɛwaxi dangife mixi baloxi ra.
Mixi naxan mu barixi sinden,
nee xa hɛɛri dangi mixi faxaxi nun mixi baloxi ra,
barima e mu ɲaxankatɛ kolon naxan na rabafe yi duniɲa ma.

content: N bara a to, mixi walima e xunnakeli fenma milɛ kui. Yi fan findixi fe fufafu nan na, alɔ birafe foye fɔxɔ ra.

content.text: Xaxilitare a bɛlɛxɛe findigilinxi a ma, a mu walima,
han a xun nakana.
Bɔɲɛsa dondoronti fisa katɛ gbegbe bɛ.
Na katɛ luxi nɛ alɔ mixi naxan birama foye fɔxɔ ra.

content: N bara fe fufafu gbɛtɛ fan to yi duniɲa ma.

content.text: Xɛmɛ nde nu na naxan nu na a kerenyi ma,
mixi yo mu nu na a bɛ.
A nu walima tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ a mu wasa a xa naafuli ra.
A naxa a yɛtɛ maxɔrin,
«N na walife tɔɔrɛ kui nde bɛ?»
Yi mɔɔli fan findixi fe fufafu nan na.
Mixi firin malanxi sɔɔnɛya dangife mixi ra naxan luma a keren.
Na firinyie xa wali dangi na mixi kerenyi gbe ra.
Xa a sa li keren bira, a boore a rakelima nɛ.
Kɔnɔ mixi naxan birama, a malima mu na,
na tɔɔrɔma nɛ a ɲaaxi ra.
Na maniyaxi mixi firin nan na,
naxee saxi e boore fɛ ma xinbeli tɛmui,
e nu wuyenyi sɔtɔ e boore saabui ra.
Kɔnɔ mixi naxan na a kerenyi ma, na xinbeli bama di?
Mixi ɲaaxi nɔma nɛ mixi keren na,
kɔnɔ mixi firin tan tima nɛ a kanke.
Luuti xɔri saxan malanxi mu bolonma mafuren.

content: Misikiinɛ xa di naxan xaxili fan, a sɛnbɛ gbo mangɛ bɛ naxan mu fata marasi fanyi nun a ɲaaxi tagi rasade.
Na mixi mɔɔli nɔma minide geeli kui, a findi mangɛ ra. A barixi setareɲa nan kui, a fa mangɛya sɔtɔ.
Duniɲa mixi birin saxanyi nan nabama, i na dangi mixi gbɛtɛ fa ti i ɲɔxɔɛ ra.
Mixi wuyaxi dangixi nɛ beenun na kanyi xa bari. Mixi naxee fama a xanbi ra, a xa fe mu fama rafande e ma. Na fan findixi fe fufafu nan na, alɔ mixi naxan birafe foye fɔxɔ ra.

I na siga salide Ala xa banxi, i xa i yɛtɛ mato a fanyi ra. I na siga, i xa i tuli mati masenyi ra naxan tima naa. Na tide gbo dangife sɛrɛxɛ bafe ra naxan nabama xaxilitareɲa kui, barima xaxilitaree mu a kolon, a e na fe kobi nan xun ma na ki.
